# Third-Party Files Directory

This directory contains all files originally produced by another author and offered for use to the Aether Galaxy project. It is intended for third-party assets, libraries, and resources used in the project. Users are responsible for verifying the license terms of each file and ensuring compliance with the original authors’ requirements.

Unless otherwise noted, files are licensed under [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). When reusing or adapting material, please credit as follows:

> “Based on *Aether Galaxy* (CC BY 4.0) by Terrance Clark [https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).”

If the supplementary material is indeed under CC BY, use this template:

> “Based on [*title of work*] (CC BY 4.0) by [*author*] [https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).”

**Attribution Template:**
“This work uses [*title of work*] (CC BY 4.0) by [*author*]. Original work: [link to original].”
For non-CC BY works, include the full license text or a link to it.

---

## Important Notes

- Some files may be licensed under terms other than CC BY 4.0. Always check the individual file or subdirectory for specific licensing information. If no license is specified, assume all rights are reserved.
- All third-party materials are provided “as is,” without warranty of any kind. The Aether Galaxy project and its author(s) are not liable for any claims, damages, or legal issues arising from the use or misuse of these files. Users assume full responsibility for compliance with applicable laws.
- Since third-party materials are not produced by the original Aether Galaxy author, they are made available in whatever file format they are received and may not follow the official file formats of the main Aether Galaxy project.
- All works are fictional, and any views expressed therein do not represent the views of the original Aether Galaxy author.

---

## Contribution Guidelines

To contribute third-party files, ensure they are properly licensed and documented. Submit a pull request with the file, its license, and a clear attribution statement.
